description: Rural bamboo fence panel of split bamboo strips woven in a diagonal lattice, lashed to whole bamboo posts and rails.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Rural fence panel of split bamboo strips woven into an open diagonal lattice, framed by two whole bamboo posts and a top and bottom rail of whole bamboo, the joints lashed with dark cord Materials: Bamboo bleached silver-grey by sun with darker nodes, black mould at the lashings, splits and a few broken lattice strips at the bottom.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Fully synthetic. No third-party scanned or scraped geometry.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.92. 2,772/4,000 triangles, 3/4 draw calls, 2/3 materials, 3/6 unique geometries, two canvases at 2.7 MB. Turntable: the three openings are real, allowed on measurement; collapse ratio passed as the built depth over width (0.105).

featureReviews.evidence: Rebuilt to the plate's own measurements: post 0.13 m round (65 px at 466 px/m), rails 0.12 m lashed on the post front, a 0.066 m lath, post top open; stack rail 0.15..0.27 / band / window 0.51..0.96 / band / lath / rail 1.24..1.36 / post top 1.50 read off column x=690. Depth 0.205 m built and declared 0.21. Band table: mean |delta width| 0.089 is the declared 1.33 against the proxy's 1.24, by design (one post per tile).
featureReviews.notes: The rail ends at the post's outer edge are flat caps the plate does not show.

featureReviews.evidence: Twelve woven sections staggered 3 mm at every seam, split where the plate's bands split (0.70, 1.03/1.38 top; 0.70, 1.09/1.20 bottom), with the three openings at the plate's column runs (slot 0.26..0.39, windows 0.74..1.03 and 1.38..1.58 of the bay, 0.51..0.96 m). Strips 2.8 cm at tones 0.44..1.0, joints at 0.85 alpha; the rendered top band measures luma 148 / std 33 against the plate's 146.5 / 41 in a matched crop.
featureReviews.notes: Strip contrast still under the plate's by a fifth; the broken bottom strips are not modelled.

featureReviews.evidence: Round culms with node rings (0.3 m on the post, 0.5 m on the rails), grain, splits and near-black mould sheets phased to land at each rail end by the post; lashings as fourteen cord tori: three turns on each rail, two collars and a diagonal X on the post; the post's cut top an 11 mm rim over a 7 cm dark bore.
featureReviews.notes: Cord is rings, not a continuous helix; the plate's braided texture is not drawn.

notes: Village gardens, resort paths, temple herb plots. Tiles post to post. Placement overridden to floor. Not breakable. One post per tile: the post is on the -X end and the bay runs to the +X edge, so tiles chain along X with no doubled post at a joint. Rebuilt 2026-09-02 to the plate: the right post spans 700 px for 1.50 m (466 px/m) and is 65 px wide -> 0.14 m round; rails 55-73 px -> 0.12-0.15 m, lashed on the post FRONT (plate top-left joint). Depth = post 0.13 + rail 0.12 lashed 4.5 cm into its front = 0.205 m, declared 0.21 (was 0.08, a lattice-on-a-plane estimate; the proxy read d/h 0.105 = 0.16 with the rail smoothed into the post). Width stays the 2.00 tile.
